repo:objectstack#8 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSAaBEfQpU2yJexSJ8

N2 route · 2026-11-28T03:08Z — seat routing on the dev's measurement (report on this card; PR #38125 `Acceptance notes`), inside the seat's discretion with the maintainer's veto window open:

Route A — the lint judges the `dependsOn` reference half on the importer's whole set (`tree` and legacy `reference` too); the spec `dependsOn` describe then names `tree` as prose following the implementation.

Governing text: SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉 基本裁决原则, verbatim: 「未声明键随实现,文档随之」. Readings: the spec describe declares candidate scoping for `lookup`/`master_detail` only (`field.zod.ts:2657`); the importer scopes `tree` and `reference` too (`IMPORT_REFERENCE_TYPES`, `field-value.zod.ts:154-155`, read at `import-coerce.ts:1056-1061`); the console renders `tree` with the lookup widget, which reads `dependsOn` (`ui/packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.ts:142`). The behaviour is implemented on two sides and undeclared, so the declaration follows it and the lint covers it; route B would remove implemented behaviour and open an import-vs-picker gap. Measured producers broken by A: 0 (3 `tree` sources + 1 skill sample, none with `dependsOn`; hotcrm and cloud not measured).

Order: A edits `packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`, the file PR #38096 (#34562) is changing, so it is dispatched after #38096 lands; it is a narrowing (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, ADR-0087 ledger entry, one contract-review-tier L2). This card stays open (`Part of #37936` on PR #38125).
